prompt: A hulking humanoid golem forged from shimmering hammered copper plating, streaked with green verdigris in the seams, glowing pale-blue eyes set in a riveted faceplate. It stands hunched and heavy in a three-quarter view facing south-west, thick copper fists clenched, sparks still drifting off its freshly-cast shoulders. The background is a dim foundry interior with molten orange glow from a forge pit and dark brick walls.

A copper construct mid-stride, walking on patrol, its body built from polished copper and oxidized verdigris bronze plates riveted together, broad shoulders and heavy piston legs, a single glowing cyan eye-lens in its blocky head. Side profile facing east, one foot raised in a slow heavy step. The background is a torchlit stone workshop courtyard at dusk with scattered tools and a brick archway.

A massive automaton built from reddish-orange copper plates with bright green verdigris corrosion in every crevice, front-facing and looming toward the viewer, two glowing blue eye-lenses in a flat riveted faceplate, thick segmented copper arms hanging at its sides. The background is a dark industrial workshop of iron pipes and gears, lit by a single overhead lantern catching the copper sheen.
